requirement_understanding: The Color Master module allows administrative users to manage master data definitions for color records within the enterprise application. It encompasses complete CRUD lifecycle capabilities: creating new color records, viewing color details in dialogs, updating existing color names, and deleting redundant color records with confirmation modal options.
requirement_gaps: Maximum character length limit for `#colorName` is not explicitly defined in the UI.
Validation rule for duplicate color names (case sensitivity rules) is missing.
Behavior when attempting to delete a color record linked to downstream transactions (e.g. Inventory/Dyeing orders) is unspecified.
Pagination and soft-delete/hard-delete audit behavior were not specified.
business_rules: Color name must be mandatory and non-empty.
Color name must be unique across active master records.
System must prompt user confirmation prior to permanent row deletion.
Canceling an edit or delete action must restore original state without saving changes.
assumptions: User is authenticated and has administrative permissions for Master Data management.
The target backend API handles unique key constraints and soft-delete states.
No dependent master data must be purged when deleting an unreferenced color code.
risks: Cascading deletion issues if color ID is referenced in live production orders.
Data corruption if concurrent users edit the same color record simultaneously.
Lack of frontend input sanitization leading to XSS vulnerabilities via color name inputs.

test_strategy.scope_out: User authentication, role management, global application navigation headers.
test_strategy.rollback_plan: Execute teardown automation script to clean created test color entries and restore initial seed database snapshot.

import re
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_color_master_crud(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/master-data/color')
    page.click('button:has-text("Add Color Type")')
    page.fill('#colorName', 'Automated Color Test')
    page.click('button:has-text("Save")')
    expect(page.locator('table')).to_contain_text('Automated Color Test')

# Color Master WorkFlow Documentation

## Overview
This flow documents and automates testing of the **Color Master** management interface within the Ambica application.

## Recorded Steps Summary
1. **Navigate to Master Data**: Expand menu and select **Color Master**.
2. **Create**: Click **Add Color Type**, enter color name, click **Save**.
3. **Edit**: Open row edit dialog, modify color name, click **Save**.
4. **View**: Click view icon to review details and close modal.
5. **Delete Confirmation & Cancel**: Verify modal triggers and proper cancellation or deletion operations.
